The queen of Egypt (Elizabeth Taylor) seduces Julius Caesar (Rex Harrison), but when he is killed, she uses Mark Antony (Richard Burton) as her new protector.
programme.title: Cleopatra

programme.desc: A Broadway star (Bette Davis) takes a young and seemingly naive aspiring actress (Anne Baxter) under her wing.
programme.title: All About Eve

programme.desc: A librarian hears a sour note when a charming rogue convinces Iowa townspeople to start a boys marching band.
programme.title: The Music Man

programme.desc: Hopalong Cassidy stops Joe Weiler from instigating a prairie war between two ranchers.
programme.title: In Old Colorado

programme.desc: A bounty hunter (Glenn Ford) faces his son's killers with help from the son (Michael Burns) of an outlaw he has killed.
programme.title: Santee

programme.desc: Several would-be heirs are forced to spend a night in a haunted house in order to collect their inheritance.
programme.title: The Cat and the Canary

programme.desc: British pirate William Kidd captures Adm. Blaine's treasure ship and hides the bounty in a cave. Three years later, Kidd, posing as a sea captain, offers his services to the king as an escort ship.
programme.title: Captain Kidd

programme.desc: A blind private eye (Edward Arnold) with a guide dog probes a murder for a friend (Ann Harding) and finds a Nazi spy ring.
programme.title: Eyes in the Night

programme.desc: A New Yorker and her four sons experience love and laughter from their opinionated but well-meaning family patriarch.
programme.title: Life With Father

programme.desc: A selfish San Franciscan (Mona Freeman) loses a husband (June Duprez) in the war and marries a reformed racketeer (James Dunn).
programme.title: That Brennan Girl

programme.desc: A wealthy gold prospector is murdered by his greedy partner, and his dog sets out to avenge her master's death.
programme.title: The Painted Hills

programme.desc: The first manned flight to Mars is a flop, so a space official (Hal Holbrook) fakes it Hollywood-style for the public.
programme.title: Capricorn One

programme.desc: A painter (Charles Boyer) and singer (Irene Dunne) meet on a ship and set a date to meet later atop the Empire State Building.
programme.title: Love Affair

programme.desc: A cattle baron (John Wayne) tries to tame his wife (Maureen O'Hara) amid a feud with settlers and trouble with Indians.
programme.title: McLintock!

programme.desc: Corrupt Wisconsin lumberman Jim Fallon travels to Northern California at the dawn of the 20th century in order to gain control of a tract of redwood forest. Fallon's underhanded tactics stir resentment from everyone.
programme.title: The Big Trees

programme.desc: A boat skipper (Humphrey Bogart) flirts with a singer (Lauren Bacall) and fools Nazis on the island of Martinique.
programme.title: To Have and Have Not

programme.desc: Illinois lawyer Abraham Lincoln (Henry Fonda) becomes known for his honesty and solves a murder with a courtroom trick.
programme.title: Young Mr. Lincoln

programme.desc: An eccentric pianist (Burgess Meredith) invades a couple's (Merle Oberon, Melvyn Douglas) home and marriage.
programme.title: That Uncertain Feeling

programme.desc: A U.S. Cavalry officer (Audie Murphy) falls in love with a part-Indian missionary (Linda Lawson) in Arizona.
programme.title: Apache Rifles

programme.desc: A U.S. senator's (Victor Moore) probe of corruption leads him to Mardi Gras, a fall guy (Bob Hope) and a filibuster.
programme.title: Louisiana Purchase

programme.desc: Two rival radio producers race to get an audience-participation program off the ground and over the airwaves.
programme.title: People Are Funny

programme.desc: A lusty Greek peasant (Anthony Quinn) shows a British writer (Alan Bates) how to live and run a lignite mine.
programme.title: Zorba the Greek

programme.desc: In a society where life ends at age 30, a law enforcement officer known as a Sandman (Michael York) flees with another 30-year-old (Jenny Agutter) when he learns his number has come up prematurely.
programme.title: Logan's Run

programme.desc: A Broadway star (Bette Davis) takes a young and seemingly naive aspiring actress (Anne Baxter) under her wing.
programme.title: All About Eve

programme.desc: A reporter writes a fictitious column about a man named John Doe, who claims to despair at America's neglect of the little people and plans to kill himself. To maintain the ruse, the newspaper hires a ballplayer-turned-hobo to pose as John Doe.
programme.title: Meet John Doe

programme.desc: An outlaw (Henry Fonda) working for a railroad magnate fights a stranger (Charles Bronson) for a New Orleans widow's (Claudia Cardinale) land.
programme.title: Once Upon a Time in the West

programme.desc: A retired cat burglar (Cary Grant) sees fireworks with an American heiress (Grace Kelly) on the Riviera.
programme.title: To Catch a Thief

programme.desc: After returning to Hawaii from being in the army, a pineapple tycoon's rebellious son turns into an island tour guide with his girlfriend.
programme.title: Blue Hawaii

programme.desc: A drifter (John Garfield) stops at a Greek diner and helps the owner's (Cecil Kellaway) lusty wife (Lana Turner) become a widow.
programme.title: The Postman Always Rings Twice

programme.desc: An American secret agent tries to retrieve a roll of microfilm in South Africa before it falls into communist hands.
programme.title: The Cape Town Affair

programme.desc: A couple (Dick Van Dyke, Debbie Reynolds) break up after 15 years of marriage, then get back together as the easy way out.
programme.title: Divorce American Style

programme.desc: A peace officer settles a quarrel between twins, the offspring of an American Indian mother and a white father.
programme.title: White Comanche

programme.desc: A French diplomat (Jean-Pierre Aumont) falls for a recent graduate (Ginger Rogers) of a Paris school for pickpockets.
programme.title: Heartbeat

programme.desc: A stewardess (Doris Day) runs for her life once she realizes her second husband (Louis Jourdan) killed her first.
programme.title: Julie

programme.desc: A 110-year-old former Louisiana slave (Cicely Tyson) reminisces about her life and society from the Civil War to germinating civil rights.
programme.title: The Autobiography of Miss Jane Pittman

programme.desc: A poor but hopeful boy seeks one of the five coveted golden tickets that will send him on a tour of Willy Wonka's mysterious chocolate factory.
programme.title: Willy Wonka and the Chocolate Factory

programme.desc: Two vaudeville flops (Bing Crosby, Bob Hope) pose as bad guys and join the Klondike gold rush with a saloon singer (Dorothy Lamour).
programme.title: Road to Utopia

programme.desc: A small-town Mississippi boss tries to pair his daughter (Joanne Woodward) with an enigmatic drifter (Paul Newman).
programme.title: The Long, Hot Summer

programme.desc: A secret agent (Dean Martin) stops a Chinese villain's atomic plot in the first of four Matt Helm movies.
programme.title: The Silencers

programme.desc: An agent (Tom Ewell) turns the girlfriend (Jayne Mansfield) of a former gangster (Edmond O'Brien) into a rock 'n' roll star.
programme.title: The Girl Can't Help It

programme.desc: A space scientist (Hugh Marlowe) figures out how to down a fleet of alien spacecraft looming over Washington, D.C.

programme.desc: The Southerner (Gene Tierney) and her husband (Randolph Scott) are still fighting the Civil War, chased by a Union major (Dana Andrews) smitten with Belle.

programme.desc: An outlaw (John Wayne), a prostitute (Claire Trevor), a drunken doctor and assorted others go through Indian country.
